app.description: Organize IPAs, repositories, certificates, and diagnostics in one place.
app.name: DreamByte AppHub
certs.emptyBody: Import a provisioning profile (.mobileprovision) or a certificate (.p12) to review its validity.
certs.expiredBody: This profile has expired and cannot sign apps.
certs.p12PasswordBody: The password is used only to import the identity into the keychain.
certs.removeBody: The local record will be removed. The keychain identity is unchanged.
certs.securityNote: Private keys stay in the iOS keychain and are never included in diagnostics.
certs.subject: Subject
certs.title: Certificates & profiles
common.name: Name
dashboard.subtitle: Your library and tools at a glance
dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.welcomeBody: Import an IPA or connect a repository to get started.
diagnostics.privacyNote: The report excludes pairing-file paths, passwords, and private keys.
diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
downloads.emptyBody: Downloads from repositories will appear here.
downloads.fileMissing: The downloaded file no longer exists.
downloads.noAutoInstall: Downloads are validated and kept in quarantine. AppHub never installs automatically.
downloads.removeBody: The downloaded file will be deleted.
downloads.sizeMismatch: Size does not match the source.
downloads.title: Downloads
error.archiveTooLarge: The archive exceeds the safety limits.
error.certificateUnreadable: The certificate could not be read.
error.entryTooLarge: An archive entry is too large.
error.fileRead: The file could not be read.
error.fileWrite: The file could not be saved.
error.invalidArchive: The ZIP archive is not valid.
error.notAvailable: This feature is unavailable on this device.
error.profileUnreadable: The profile could not be read.
install.modeBridgeDetail: Pairing file plus installation_proxy over a loopback connection.
install.modeExternalDetail: Share the IPA with AltStore, SideStore, or Xcode.
install.modeOtaDetail: Build a manifest or open your provider's link; iOS performs the install.
install.modeSigningDetail: Re-sign the IPA with an imported identity before installing.
install.pickOther: You can switch modes in Settings.
install.preferredFooter: AppHub preselects this mode and shows what each one needs.
install.title: Installation
ipa.cloudPlaceholder: The file is still in iCloud. Download it in Files, then try again.
ipa.deleteBody: The imported file will be removed from AppHub. Installed apps are not affected.
ipa.emptyBody: Import an .ipa file to inspect its contents. Nothing is installed automatically.
ipa.folderHint: You can also copy .ipa files into the “DreamByte AppHub” folder in Files. AppHub imports them the next time it opens.
ipa.importPickerFailed: Could not open the selected file.
ipa.installUnavailableBody: iOS does not let one app install another directly. AppHub can hand a signed IPA to iOS through an HTTPS manifest (OTA), but signing and hosting are yours.
ipa.missingMinOS: Does not declare a minimum iOS version
ipa.notAFile: The selected item is not a file.
ipa.quarantinedNote: Quarantined file: it is never executed automatically.
ipa.title: IPA library
ipa.wrongType: Choose a file with the .ipa extension.
jit.builtinUnavailable: Built-in activation requires a helper extension and Xcode. It is not included in this build.
jit.disclaimer: AppHub cannot enable JIT by itself and cannot guarantee compatibility with every iOS version.
jit.handoffNote: StikDebug will open with the current PID. Success is only confirmed once the process has JIT.
jit.pairingInvalid: The pairing file is not valid.
jit.pairingNote: On iPadOS 26 and earlier the pairing file must be created once with a computer (iloader or idevice_pair). On-device pairing starts with iPadOS 27.
jit.pidHelp: iOS does not expose other apps' PIDs. Copy it from the tool that launched the target app; AppHub cannot detect it.
jit.settingsMethodNote: The method is stored on this device.
jit.step2: Enable Developer Mode on the device.
jit.step3: Connect a loopback VPN (for example, LocalDevVPN).
jit.step4: Open StikDebug and select this app.
jit.step5: Return to AppHub and check the status.
jit.title: JIT
library.removeBody: Only the local record is removed; the installed app is unchanged.
library.systemUnavailableBody: iOS does not allow enumerating every installed app through public APIs. This view only shows AppHub records.
library.title: Library
ota.generated: Manifest ready to share. Upload it next to the IPA, then open its URL.
ota.intro: iOS can install a signed IPA from an HTTPS manifest. AppHub prepares the manifest or opens your provider's install link; iOS performs the install.
ota.invalidLink: Enter an HTTPS manifest URL or a valid itms-services link.
ota.ipaPlaceholder: Public HTTPS URL of the signed IPA
ota.noSigningBody: AppHub does not sign IPAs, ships no certificates, and does not block Apple's revocation checks. Use your own signing service or certificate.
ota.requirementsBody: A signed IPA (enterprise, ad-hoc, or development), an HTTPS host for the IPA, and a manifest at an HTTPS URL. iOS shows the install prompt; the certificate must be trusted in Settings.
ota.title: Install via OTA
ota.unconfirmed: AppHub cannot confirm the result; check the Home Screen and Settings › VPN & Device Management.
repos.addBody: Enter the URL of a JSON file compatible with AltSource v2.
repos.deleteBody: The source and its cache will be removed. Downloaded files are kept.
repos.emptyBody: Add a source to browse available applications.
repos.invalidURL: Enter a valid http or https URL.
repos.title: Repositories
settings.aboutBody: DreamByte AppHub organizes IPAs, repositories, and diagnostics. Installation requires compatible external tools.
settings.appDescription: App and repository manager for iOS.
settings.brandingPlaceholder: Temporary placeholder: DreamByte Studios will provide the official assets.
settings.clearCacheBody: Removes repository data and thumbnails. Imported IPAs are kept.
settings.languageBody: Change the interface language. It is stored on this device.
settings.legalBody: DreamByte AppHub is a development and sideloading utility. It is not affiliated with Apple. Installing apps requires compatible external tools.
settings.licensesBody: AppHub ships without third-party runtime libraries. It uses Apple's frameworks and the system zlib.
settings.privacyBody: All data stays on this device. Repositories are fetched only when you add or refresh them; diagnostics never include keys or pairing paths.
settings.resetLibraryBody: Removes all local IPA records. Apps are not uninstalled.
settings.title: Settings
